spec_section_updates.section_4: Post-dev-fix-pass-2 QA cycle (2026-05-18). react_template.tpl is now 2897 lines. fix_pass_2 successfully resolved 4 of 6 original blockers: AC14 (TimelineView tap-to-select — PASS), AC15 (accommodation in CandidatesSidebar — PASS), AC18 (_isCompatible full enforcement — PASS), AC22 major badges (missing/late-arrival/data-droppable for meals and activity slots — PASS). 2 blockers remain critical failures: AC12/AC23 (fetchRoute missing mode field at line 2409 → HTTP 500 on route.py:52; route display reads data.duration_minutes at line 775 but backend returns data.segment.duration_min), AC17 (PLAN_DATA board cards carry no option_id; line 860 opt.option_id = undefined; slot-to-slot move sends null option_id). AC22 has 2 remaining minor deviations: accommodation late-arrival badge uses check_in heuristic (line 1284) instead of edAcc.late_arrival_placeholder; all skipped badges show literal 'skipped' text (lines 898, 980, 1062, 1144, 1283) instead of edSlot.skipped_reason field. EDITOR_MODE count = 0 (AC1 no regression). Python compile: all 3 Python files PASS. 23 of 29 ACs now pass (up from 19/29 in round 2).
spec_section_updates.section_6: AC12/AC23 blocked by two compounding bugs: (1) fetchRoute at line 2409 posts body { trip_id, from_option_id, to_option_id, request_seq } — 'mode' field absent. route.py handle_route at line 52 executes req['mode'] as direct dict access with no default, raising KeyError → HTTP 500. No route data is ever returned. (2) Even if mode were added, the frontend at line 775 reads data.duration_minutes from the response, but route.py _ok_response (line 227) returns { status, segment: {...}, source } where travel time is nested in segment.duration_min, not top-level duration_minutes. Both bugs must be fixed together for AC12 to function. AC17 blocked by PLAN_DATA card option_id absence: mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay stamps card.selected = true but does not stamp card.option_id. Board-drag onDragStart at line 860 sends opt.option_id which is undefined for PLAN_DATA cards. JSON.stringify silently drops undefined keys. The slot-to-slot 2-mutation batch receives option_id: null, effectively clearing the destination slot instead of moving the card. AC22 minor: accommodation late-arrival badge at line 1284 checks acc.check_in hour >= 14 heuristic; the canonical field edAcc.late_arrival_placeholder is checked for isGated (line 1291) but not for the badge. Skipped badges (lines 898, 980, 1062, 1144, 1283) show literal 'skipped' text instead of edSlot.skipped_reason.
spec_section_updates.section_7: Required fixes for next dev cycle (fix_pass_3): (1) AC12/AC23 fix A: add mode field to fetchRoute POST body at line 2409. Determine the correct mode string from route.py accepted values (e.g. 'transit'). Add a ROUTE_MODE constant and include it in the JSON body. (2) AC12/AC23 fix B: at line 775, change data.duration_minutes to data.segment && data.segment.duration_min to match route.py _ok_response shape. (3) AC17 fix: in mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay (lines 1906-1927), after stamping card.selected = true, also stamp card.option_id from the corresponding editorDay slot's resolved option_id. (4) AC22 minor fix: at line 1284, replace the check_in heuristic with: if (edAcc.late_arrival_placeholder) return <...>late arrival</...>. (5) AC22 minor fix: at lines 898, 980, 1062, 1144, 1283, replace the literal 'skipped' text with {edSlot.skipped_reason || 'skipped'} (and {edAcc.skipped_reason || 'skipped'} for line 1283).

Release blocked by 2 critical ACs (AC12/AC23 and AC17).

all_findings.issue: AC12/AC23: fetchRoute POST body missing 'mode' field. route.py handle_route at line 52 executes req['mode'] as direct dict access with no default → KeyError → HTTP 500. All /api/route calls fail. Route gaps never displayed or retried successfully.
all_findings.recommendation: Add mode field to fetchRoute POST body at line 2409. Determine correct transport mode string from route.py (e.g. 'transit'). Add ROUTE_MODE constant and include in JSON body: { trip_id: TRIP_ID, from_option_id: fromOptionId, to_option_id: toOptionId, request_seq: seq, mode: ROUTE_MODE }.

all_findings.issue: AC12/AC23: Route display reads data.duration_minutes (top-level) from routeCache entry. route.py _ok_response returns { status, segment: {...}, source } where travel time is in segment.duration_min — not top-level duration_minutes. Even if mode bug fixed, route duration would never display.
all_findings.recommendation: At line 775, change data.duration_minutes to: data.segment && data.segment.duration_min to match backend _ok_response shape from route.py.

all_findings.issue: AC17: PLAN_DATA placed cards do not carry option_id. mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay stamps card.selected = true but does not stamp card.option_id. onDragStart at line 860 sends opt.option_id which is undefined for all PLAN_DATA-sourced placed cards. JSON.stringify silently drops undefined → payload has no optionId. Slot-to-slot 2-mutation batch sends option_id: null → destination slot is cleared instead of receiving the moved card.
all_findings.recommendation: In mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay (lines 1906-1927), after resolving the effective selection for each slot, stamp the matched option's option_id onto the card object. All placed cards must carry option_id before KanbanView renders. Alternatively, resolve option_id in the onDragStart handler by looking up the slot's editorSelections entry.

all_findings.issue: AC22 deviation: Accommodation late-arrival badge uses check_in heuristic (parseInt(acc.check_in.split(':')[0]) >= 14) instead of edAcc.late_arrival_placeholder field. isGated at line 1291 correctly uses edAcc.late_arrival_placeholder for droppability, but badge and gate can be inconsistent.
all_findings.recommendation: At line 1284, replace the check_in heuristic with: if (edAcc.late_arrival_placeholder) return <...>late arrival</...>.

all_findings.issue: AC22 deviation: All 5 skipped badges render the literal string 'skipped' instead of showing the skipped_reason field. AC22 spec requires showing skipped_reason from the slot's skipped_reason field.
all_findings.recommendation: Replace 'skipped' literal text with {edSlot.skipped_reason || 'skipped'} in lines 898, 980, 1062, 1144 and {edAcc.skipped_reason || 'skipped'} in line 1283.
